subject: Astronomy & Space
title: Proxima Centauri b
description: A quick, practical guide to Proxima Centauri b.

hook.text: Proxima Centauri b is the closest known exoplanet to Earth—just 4.2 light-years away, orbiting the nearest star.

buildup.text: It sits in the habitable zone and has a minimum mass of 1.2 Earths. Its year is just 11.2 days.

discovery.text: Guillem Anglada-Escudé's team found it in 2016 using the radial velocity method, analyzing years of precision data.

twist.text: Proxima Centauri is a flare star. A 2018 superflare was 10 times more powerful than any recorded solar flare.

climax.text: Whether it has an atmosphere—or if the star's flares have stripped it bare—is a major target for future observations.

punchline.text: The nearest exoplanet, potentially habitable. But its star has a violent temper.

quiz.question: What is the main concern about habitability on Proxima Centauri b?
options: The host star's frequent and powerful flares may have stripped its atmosphere
It orbits too far from its star to receive enough heat
It is too massive for liquid water to exist on its surface

details.summary: Proxima Centauri b is a roughly Earth-mass planet orbiting in the habitable zone of Proxima Centauri — the closest star to our Sun at just 4.24 light-years away. Discovered in 2016, it orbits every 11.2 days.
details.whyItMatters: As the nearest known exoplanet in a habitable zone, Proxima b could be our first target for interstellar exploration. Understanding its conditions is crucial for assessing the prevalence of life in the galaxy.
takeaways: Nearest known potentially habitable exoplanet at 4.24 light-years
Roughly Earth-mass in its star's habitable zone
Habitability uncertain due to host star's intense flares

faq.question: Could we send a spacecraft to Proxima Centauri b?
faq.answer: The Breakthrough Starshot project proposes sending tiny light-sail probes accelerated to 20% of light speed by powerful ground-based lasers. At that speed, the journey would take about 20 years, plus 4 years for data to return. Current rocket technology would take tens of thousands of years.

faq.question: Does Proxima b have an atmosphere?
faq.answer: Unknown. The intense flares from Proxima Centauri may have stripped any atmosphere over billions of years. However, volcanic outgassing or a strong magnetic field could replenish or protect an atmosphere.
